purpose: Freeze the historical F1-F6 task-family rubric for prospective S2 assignment without treatment-result influence.
assignment_rule: Primary family follows requested work in the task statement, not incidental contents of a reference/gold solution. Exactly one primary family is required before admission.

F1.name: Localized defect repair
F1.definition: Incorrect branch/boundary, localized parsing or serialization error, or small API behavior regression solvable with a small working set.

F2.name: Cross-file / integration defect repair
F2.definition: Defect spanning interfaces, implementations, modules, service/domain/persistence boundaries, or dependency interactions requiring multiple local contexts.

F3.name: Feature / behavior change
F3.definition: Bounded new behavior, domain rule extension, supported input variant, or small capability implemented from specification without subsystem redesign.

F4.name: Test generation / test completion
F4.definition: Add or strengthen regression/property/edge-case coverage to encode an existing behavioral contract.

F5.name: Refactor / code-quality / review-driven correction
F5.definition: Behavior-preserving refactor, concrete review finding, structural cleanup, or deterministic style/static-analysis correction requiring code changes.

F6.name: Configuration / build / dependency / repository integration
F6.definition: Build/configuration/dependency/CI/repository wiring work where environment and tooling are central.
